newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks finish on feeble tone, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks finish on feeble tone, trade thin.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended on a feeble tone for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday, with market activity subdued by a lack of factors to steer it in a certain direction, brokers said. They added that most of the fluctuations during the session came from futures-linked trade.
The 225-issue Nikkei average closed 78.66 points, or 0.37 percent, lower ar 21,003.49. Its December futures finished 10 points lower at 21,090.
"Trade was thin with no firm direction, and most of the Nikkei's dips and sways were coming from arbitrage-linked activity," said Kenzo Doi, strategist at Kokusai Securities.
Brokers said investors discounted the interim special losses the lumber dealing company said it would post due to the filing for bankruptcy of its unit Nichiei Finance.
Declining issues totalled 699 issues against 317 which advanced. There were 210 issues unchanged.

In sectors, precision instruments, gas, land transport, rubber and foods were the main gainers. Railway/bus, real estate, insurance, miscellaneous manufacturers and sea transport headed the list of retreaters.
The over-the-counter index was down 7.67 points or 0.50 percent at 1,511.18 in late Tokyo.
